scope: Task1 tests and prospective internal interfaces only; no execution authority

common.validate_config(c): closed full_score config and explicitly reviewed bound resources; rejects every null and old authority flag
common.verify_existing_bank(c): return original pinned file/manifest/internal-payload identities; no adoption, write, native bank regeneration or score symlink
common.full_score_command(c): return sole original shell CLI argv with stage score and no limit argument
common.validate_score_command(c, command): exact external argv policy, including rejection of explicit --limit 0
common.validate_gpu_identity(c, probe): exact name/device-type/dtype/numeric_environment; return bank_gpu_uuid and actual_gpu_uuid separately
common.effective_deadlines(c, initial_end, curr: fresh min initial/current/fixed run deadline; work deadline subtracts reviewed margin; remaining computed from current clock, never memoized submission time
common.environment(): postactivation offline/project/cache/thread environment using bound config
common.gpu_release(phase): only full_score; finite fresh root release without renewal
common.entry_release(r, phase): final fresh hash/catalogue/allocation/deadline/lease validation and once-only consumption

host-launch.validate_allocation(c, captured): actual fresh raw/fields identity, host, RUNNING account/QoS, exactly one typed H100 GPU, reviewed CPU/RAM/time and no restart/requeue
host-launch.build_container_command(c, profile): original /projects and /work namespaces; base Alignment read-only; MAIN parent read-write; every existing non-output leaf read-only; cache/source/input/bank/G3/SIF protected

controller.run_full_score(c, r): always invoke genuine internal preflight; recompute remaining work/lease immediately before final entry and sole Popen; native completion audit after normal exit; no retry
controller.preflight_full_score(c, r): internal owning guard/activation/probe boundary, returning environment/work_deadline and before evidence
controller.audit_score_result(c): internal normal native completion/domain/control/support audit, not scientific result acceptance or effects permission
controller.terminate_process_group(child, timeout_s: TERM group, bounded wait, KILL group if needed and reap

test_boundary: Tests may monkeypatch module-level external I/O/native audit seams. Production function parameters must not permit caller-supplied guard success, model-provider callbacks or loader injection. Substantive config/bank/release/allocation/deadline checks have separate real behavioral tests.
fixture_limit: Complete authentic bank metadata shape and contracts, with vectors deliberately stripped. This fixture cannot pass owning native validate_banks and does not claim that proof. Actual bank version metadata is observed provenance, never a spoof of the CPU test interpreter.
